basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Jammu Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Biochemistry project at All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Vijaypur, Jammu, needs one Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) on contract for the ICMR-funded National Health Research Priority (NHRP) project "Investigation the role of Ubiquitously Transcribed Tetratricopeptide Repeat Containing, Y-Linked (UTY) in stemness of oral cancer cells". The pay is Rs 56000 + 10% HRA = Rs 61600 per month in the 1st and 2nd year. The essential qualification is a First Class Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees in life sciences/Biochemistry/Biotechnol

The competent authority may assign any duty as required, with no extra allowance. No TA is admissible for attending the interview or for joining the duties. A candidate found canvassing for selection will be disqualified. Incorrect or false declarations or wilful suppression of information can lead to removal from service and other action. The decision of the competent authority on selection is final; no representations will be entertained. AIIMS Jammu reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process at any time. No separate communication will be sent about changes in the date and time of the interview/written exam; the website www.aiimsjammu.edu.in carries updates.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Vijaypur, Jammu is described on its letterhead as a Central Autonomous Body under PMSSY, MoH&FW, Government of India. This post is purely temporary and on contract basis, and it serves the ICMR-funded NHRP project on UTY in oral cancer cell stemness. Queries go to the Principal Investigator, Dr Manish Kumar, Associate Professor, Department of Biochemistry, AIIMS Vijaypur, Jammu.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: First Class Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees in life sciences/Biochemistry/Biotechnology. Second Class Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees with PhD. Experience in conducting, analysing and report writing of molecular cancer research studies. Publication in peer reviewed journal, preferably in PubMed indexed journal. Basic course/workshop in qualitative research methods; hands on experience on small animal handling and conducting research. Knowledge of using Graphpad (Prism) or strata software for experiment result analysis. Good reading, writing and communication skills in English and Hindi. Hands on experience on molecular biology, especially RT-PCR and western blotting, MTT Assay, RNA Sequencing and Next generation Sequencing techniques and data analysis. Hands on experience on animal experimental techniques. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment is initially for 12 months from the date of joining. It is extendable up to the end of the project, i.e. February, 2028, depending on the candidate's performance, project requirement and availability of budget or fund. If the contract is not extended, it lapses automatically. No other or additional allowances are admissible beyond the consolidated salary, and the appointee is not entitled to the benefits of regular AIIMS Jammu employees. Leave is governed by ICMR guidelines.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jammu Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) Job Description
content_sections.text: Accountability for designing, conducting and analysing experiments to meet the project's objectives. The study needs a person trained in molecular biology, i.e. cloning, transfection, RNA and DNA isolation, western blotting and RT-PCR. The work involves extensive eukaryotic cell and bacterial culture work, spheroid preparation, animal experiments etc. for cell freezing and culture respectively. Accountability for designing, conducting and analysing animal experiments at AIIMS New Delhi during 2027 to 2028, i.e. the third year of the project. Coordinate with ICMR and update on project progress; participate in review meetings/trainings. Perform any other work assigned by the PI/Co-PI. Selected candidates are expected to work from the AIIMS Vijaypur campus and to travel to AIIMS Delhi, as mentioned in the job responsibilities.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jammu Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Open the Institute's website, www.aiimsjammu.edu.in , where the online application form is available under open jobs. Complete the form by 30 November 2026 (Monday), 5pm. Give correct information, documents and photographs; the applicant is responsible for their authenticity. Submit a separate application for each post if applying for more than one post. Candidates employed in a government job must provide a No Objection Certificate from their employer. The notice does not list other documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The stages are: list of eligible candidates, shortlisting if needed, and interview. A list of eligible candidates will be uploaded on the official website of AIIMS Jammu and on the job portal. Merely possessing the prescribed qualifications does not ensure a call for interview. Candidates may be shortlisted based on the merit needed for the project. If the number of applications for the post exceeds 10, candidates will be shortlisted on past academic performance and research experience. Candidates falling in the merit may be called in a ratio of 10:1 for the interview, or as decided by the competent authority. Selection of the shortlisted candidates is based on scores obtained in the interview. In case of a tie in the final marks, seniority on the basis of date of birth is considered. Assessment focuses on knowledge in the relevant area of the project, and includes quantitative and qualitative data management, analysis and reporting. Only shortlisted candidates are intimated by a call letter through email. Interviews are conducted in person at the AIIMS Jammu Campus. The interview date is not specified in the notice.
